scenarios.title: A｜东西落在酒店
scenarios.setting: 在“物品遗失”情景中，你将练习如何用英语处理“东西落在酒店”。

turns.text: Good afternoon. How can I help you?

turns.prompt: 你想补充遗失物品的特征或可能遗落的位置，会怎么说？

choices.text: Hi, I stayed at your hotel last night, and I think I left something in my room.

feedback.naturalExpression: Hi, I stayed at your hotel last night, and I think I left something in my room.
feedback.explanation: “I think”把话说成个人判断，为讨论留出空间；后面的具体理由才是沟通重点。

choices.text: I checked out this morning, but I may have left something behind.

feedback.naturalExpression: I checked out this morning, but I may have left something behind.
feedback.explanation: “may have left”表示可能遗落了物品，地点尚未完全确定，语气保留了核实空间。

choices.text: I’m calling about an item I think I forgot in my room.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m calling about an item I think I forgot in my room.
feedback.explanation: “I think”把话说成个人判断，为讨论留出空间；后面的具体理由才是沟通重点。

choices.text: I think I left one of my belongings at the hotel.

feedback.naturalExpression: I think I left one of my belongings at the hotel.
feedback.explanation: “I think”把话说成个人判断，为讨论留出空间；后面的具体理由才是沟通重点。

choices.text: I forgot something in hotel when I checked out.

feedback.naturalExpression: Hi, I stayed at your hotel last night, and I think I left something in my room.
feedback.explanation: 明确遗落地点时用“left something at the hotel”；“the hotel”也不能省去冠词。

turns.text: Certainly. What did you leave behind?

turns.prompt: 你想补充遗失物品的特征或可能遗落的位置，会怎么说？

choices.text: I think I left a black jacket in the closet.

feedback.naturalExpression: I think I left a black jacket in the closet.
feedback.explanation: “I think”把话说成个人判断，为讨论留出空间；后面的具体理由才是沟通重点。

choices.text: I may have left my headphones on the bedside table.

feedback.naturalExpression: I may have left my headphones on the bedside table.
feedback.explanation: “may have left”表示可能遗落了物品，地点尚未完全确定，语气保留了核实空间。

choices.text: It’s a small blue bag. I think it was in the bathroom.

feedback.naturalExpression: It’s a small blue bag. I think it was in the bathroom.
feedback.explanation: “I think”把话说成个人判断，为讨论留出空间；后面的具体理由才是沟通重点。

choices.text: I left a thing in my room.

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: I think I left a black jacket in the closet.
feedback.explanation: “a thing”信息太少；报出物品名称，再补充颜色或位置，更方便寻找。

turns.text: What room were you staying in?

turns.prompt: 告诉对方你的房间号，方便对方处理，会怎么说？

choices.text: Room 806. I checked out at around ten this morning.

feedback.naturalExpression: Room 806. I checked out at around ten this morning.
feedback.explanation: 用时间短语标明时点或持续时长，让对方能据此安排，而不只知道一个模糊的“晚点”。

choices.text: I was in room 806, under Alex Chen.

feedback.naturalExpression: I was in room 806, under Alex Chen.
feedback.explanation: “under Alex Chen”表示登记在这个姓名之下，工作人员可以据此查找预订记录。

choices.text: I can’t remember the room number, but the reservation was under Alex Chen.

feedback.naturalExpression: I can’t remember the room number, but the reservation was under Alex Chen.
feedback.explanation: “I can’t”明确说明无法完成的动作或限制，方便对方判断需要什么帮助或替代办法。

turns.text: I’ll check with housekeeping and lost and found.

turns.prompt: 你想了解找到遗失物品后的联系和领取安排，会怎么说？

choices.text: Could you let me know if you find it?

feedback.naturalExpression: Could you let me know if you find it?
feedback.explanation: “Could you …?”把希望对方做的动作写进问句，是常见的委婉请求。

choices.text: How can I get it back if it’s been found?

feedback.naturalExpression: How can I get it back if it’s been found?
feedback.explanation: 用问句确认自己能否这样做，既说明所需动作，也让对方有机会解释限制。

choices.text: Would you be able to mail it to me?

feedback.naturalExpression: Would you be able to mail it to me?
feedback.explanation: “would you be able to”询问对方是否能够帮忙或作出安排，比直接要求照办更留有余地。

choices.text: Can I come back and pick it up?

feedback.naturalExpression: Can I come back and pick it up?
feedback.explanation: 用问句确认自己能否这样做，既说明所需动作，也让对方有机会解释限制。

scenarios.title: B｜钱包 / 手机丢失
scenarios.setting: 在“物品遗失”情景中，你将练习如何用英语处理“钱包 / 手机丢失”。

turns.prompt: 你想说明物品遗失或找不到的情况，会怎么说？

choices.text: Hi, I can’t find my wallet. Has anyone turned one in?

feedback.naturalExpression: Hi, I can’t find my wallet. Has anyone turned one in?
feedback.explanation: “I can’t”明确说明无法完成的动作或限制，方便对方判断需要什么帮助或替代办法。

choices.text: I think I’ve lost my phone somewhere in the hotel.

feedback.naturalExpression: I think I’ve lost my phone somewhere in the hotel.
feedback.explanation: “I think”把话说成个人判断，为讨论留出空间；后面的具体理由才是沟通重点。

choices.text: Has anyone handed in a black wallet?

feedback.naturalExpression: Has anyone handed in a black wallet?
feedback.explanation: 给出颜色和物品特征，帮助工作人员把它与相似物品区分开，适合失物核对。

choices.text: Could you check your lost and found for me?

feedback.naturalExpression: Could you check your lost and found for me?
feedback.explanation: “Could you …?”把希望对方做的动作写进问句，是常见的委婉请求。

choices.text: Did somebody give you my lost wallet?

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: Hi, I can’t find my wallet. Has anyone turned one in?
feedback.explanation: 这句能理解；失物招领中“turn in”专门表示有人拾获后上交，比“give you”更具体。

turns.text: Certainly. Where did you last see it?

turns.prompt: 你想补充遗失物品的特征或可能遗落的位置，会怎么说？

choices.text: I think I had it in the lobby this morning.

feedback.naturalExpression: I think I had it in the lobby this morning.
feedback.explanation: “I think”把话说成个人判断，为讨论留出空间；后面的具体理由才是沟通重点。

choices.text: The last time I remember seeing it was at breakfast.

feedback.naturalExpression: The last time I remember seeing it was at breakfast.
feedback.explanation: “I remember”说明自己记得的情况，便于与对方一起核对经过。

choices.text: I may have left it by the pool.

feedback.naturalExpression: I may have left it by the pool.
feedback.explanation: “may have left”表示可能遗落了物品，地点尚未完全确定，语气保留了核实空间。

choices.text: I’m not sure. I’ve already checked my room.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m not sure. I’ve already checked my room.
feedback.explanation: “I’ve already”强调这一步已经做过，能在沟通中确认进度。

turns.text: Could you describe it for me?

turns.prompt: 你想补充遗失物品的特征或可能遗落的位置，会怎么说？

choices.text: It’s a small black leather wallet.

feedback.naturalExpression: It’s a small black leather wallet.
feedback.explanation: 给出颜色和物品特征，帮助工作人员把它与相似物品区分开，适合失物核对。

choices.text: It’s a silver phone with a clear case.

feedback.naturalExpression: It’s a silver phone with a clear case.
feedback.explanation: 给出颜色和物品特征，帮助工作人员把它与相似物品区分开，适合失物核对。

choices.text: My ID and two credit cards are inside the wallet.

feedback.naturalExpression: My ID and two credit cards are inside the wallet.
feedback.explanation: “inside the wallet”说明钱包里的内容，适合失物辨认或说明需要挂失哪些证件。

choices.text: There’s a small sticker on the back of the phone.

feedback.naturalExpression: There’s a small sticker on the back of the phone.
feedback.explanation: 用具体规格或位置回应对方，便于落实选择；上下文已明确时，不必重复整项需求。

turns.text: Nothing matching that description has been turned in yet.

turns.prompt: 你想请酒店继续留意遗失的物品，会怎么说？

choices.text: Could you contact me if someone turns it in?

feedback.naturalExpression: Could you contact me if someone turns it in?
feedback.explanation: “Could you …?”把希望对方做的动作写进问句，是常见的委婉请求。

choices.text: Could you check with housekeeping as well?

feedback.naturalExpression: Could you check with housekeeping as well?
feedback.explanation: “as well”表示也、还，常用于在已有事项上补充另一项需求。

choices.text: Is there anywhere else in the hotel I should check?

feedback.naturalExpression: Is there anywhere else in the hotel I should check?
feedback.explanation: 先确认有没有所需的物品、服务或安排，为后面的选择提供依据。

choices.text: What should I do if it isn’t found?

feedback.naturalExpression: What should I do if it isn’t found?
feedback.explanation: 征求建议或确认下一步，适合流程不熟悉时请对方指导。

scenarios.title: C｜怀疑物品被拿走
scenarios.setting: 在“物品遗失”情景中，你将练习如何用英语处理“怀疑物品被拿走”。

turns.prompt: 你想补充遗失物品的特征或可能遗落的位置，会怎么说？

choices.text: Hi, I can’t find something that I left in my room.

feedback.naturalExpression: Hi, I can’t find something that I left in my room.
feedback.explanation: “I can’t”明确说明无法完成的动作或限制，方便对方判断需要什么帮助或替代办法。

choices.text: One of my belongings seems to be missing from my room.

feedback.naturalExpression: One of my belongings seems to be missing from my room.
feedback.explanation: “seems to be missing”表示看起来遗失或缺失了，尚未直接断定原因。

choices.text: I left my watch on the desk, but it’s no longer there.

feedback.naturalExpression: I left my watch on the desk, but it’s no longer there.
feedback.explanation: “no longer”表示原来的状态已经结束，能说明现在与过去的不同。

choices.text: I can’t find my watch, and I’m sure I left it in the room.

feedback.naturalExpression: I can’t find my watch, and I’m sure I left it in the room.
feedback.explanation: “I can’t”明确说明无法完成的动作或限制，方便对方判断需要什么帮助或替代办法。

choices.text: Someone stole my watch from my room.

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: Hi, I can’t find something that I left in my room.
feedback.explanation: “stole”直接断定遭窃；尚未核实原因时，先说手表不见了，更准确地反映已知情况。

turns.text: I’m sorry to hear that. When did you last see it?

turns.prompt: 关于「物品遗失」，对方在核实情况，你会怎样回答并补充必要的信息？

choices.text: It was on the desk when I left this morning.

feedback.naturalExpression: It was on the desk when I left this morning.
feedback.explanation: “this morning”明确是哪一天的时段，谈当前日期时前面不必加介词。

choices.text: I’m certain it was there before I went out.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m certain it was there before I went out.
feedback.explanation: 直接交代自己当前的状态或安排，能让对方据此继续交流。

choices.text: I noticed it was missing when I came back this afternoon.

feedback.naturalExpression: I noticed it was missing when I came back this afternoon.
feedback.explanation: “I noticed”把话题建立在自己观察到的现象上，适合开始说明问题。

turns.text: Have you checked your luggage and the rest of the room?

turns.prompt: 你想确认信息或告诉对方已经完成，会怎么说？

choices.text: Yes, I’ve checked everywhere.

feedback.naturalExpression: Yes, I’ve checked everywhere.
feedback.explanation: “I’ve checked”说明已核查过，帮助对方了解哪些步骤已经完成。

choices.text: I have. I still can’t find it.

feedback.naturalExpression: I have. I still can’t find it.
feedback.explanation: “can’t find”表示目前找不到，不直接断定物品丢失或被偷。

choices.text: Yes. Could you check whether housekeeping found anything?

feedback.naturalExpression: Yes. Could you check whether housekeeping found anything?
feedback.explanation: “Could you …?”把希望对方做的动作写进问句，是常见的委婉请求。

choices.text: Could you help me find out what happened?

feedback.naturalExpression: Could you help me find out what happened?
feedback.explanation: “Could you …?”把希望对方做的动作写进问句，是常见的委婉请求。

turns.text: Of course. We’ll speak with housekeeping and check our records.

turns.prompt: 你想确认酒店将如何跟进遗失物品的调查，会怎么说？

choices.text: Thank you. Could you let me know what you find out?

feedback.naturalExpression: Thank you. Could you let me know what you find out?
feedback.explanation: “Could you …?”把希望对方做的动作写进问句，是常见的委婉请求。

choices.text: I’d like to report the item as missing.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’d like to report the item as missing.
feedback.explanation: “would like”清楚表达需求，语气比直接说“want”更委婉，适合提出请求或表达偏好。

choices.text: Is there a manager I could speak to about this?

feedback.naturalExpression: Is there a manager I could speak to about this?
feedback.explanation: 说明可以提供的行动或可行方案，让对话有明确的下一步。

choices.text: I’d appreciate it if you could look into this.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’d appreciate it if you could look into this.
feedback.explanation: “I’d appreciate”将希望对方做的事与感谢联系起来，语气比直接命令更委婉。
